Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا عَزِيْزُ
Translation: O Mighty, O Mighty, O Mighty
All Your creation is humbled before Your greatness
So protect me from the evil of Your creation
O Bestower of blessings, O Granter of favors

Arabic text: يَا لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
Translation: O there is no god but You, Glory be to You
Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers
So We responded to him and saved him from distress
And thus do We save the believers

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
Translation: And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure and purified family
